title: Private AI, Clear Decisions
subtitle: A local review loop for useful, accountable automation

slides.title: The trust gap
slides.content: Teams want useful AI without turning private decisions into opaque outputs.

bullet_points.title: Start with the decision
bullet_points.description: Name the audience, trade-off, and next step before asking for a draft.

bullet_points.title: Keep evidence visible
bullet_points.description: Surface unsupported claims and unresolved sources while the story is still editable.

bullet_points.title: Make ownership explicit
bullet_points.description: A named reviewer can accept, rewrite, or defer each finding.

slides.title: A private review loop
slides.content: Use deterministic checks first, then make any model-assisted step an explicit choice.

bullet_points.title: Brief locally
bullet_points.description: Keep the source brief, notes, and evidence in the local project.

bullet_points.title: Diagnose the story
bullet_points.description: Review progression, density, claims, and ownership before visual polish.

bullet_points.title: Export with proof
bullet_points.description: Ship native PowerPoint plus a receipt that records the generated artifact.

slides.title: Approve the private AI loop
slides.content: Pilot one internal AI workflow with human sign-off.

bullet_points.title: Local-first
bullet_points.description: No-key planner; evidence gaps stay visible.

bullet_points.title: Hosted model
bullet_points.description: Optional provider; disclose the network boundary.

bullet_points.title: Next action
bullet_points.description: AI program lead reviews the pilot before expansion.
